title: Children’s story panels

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study
location.extent: Published video poster and complete associated clip

slide_intent: Translate an offer into audience language, because a family should be able to imagine the experience before booking.
strategic_value: Day-specific phrases and children’s faces can make the Museum’s scientific subjects feel welcoming and playful.
demonstration: Three vertical panels animate circular letter fields around children’s faces while white headlines appear: Monday is the day for time travel, Thursdays are for big lizards, and Space explorers come on Saturdays.
practical_value: Compare headline placement above and below circular portraits in a repeated social format.

content_islands.name: Three story formats
content_islands.spec: Align orange, dark and pink rounded panels side by side.

content_islands.name: Portrait centers
content_islands.spec: Place each child’s face inside a small circular opening within letter rings.

content_islands.name: Invitations
content_islands.spec: Reveal the white headlines in different positions around the portraits.
